title: K2 Space wordmark
description: A plain-text stand-in for a logo: two wide-set light capitals words with a thin orbit icon between them, taking the surrounding text colour and sized by font size.
notes: never a copy of a real logo: the theme's font plus a lucide icon
name: k2space-wordmark

props.name: name
props.description: the first word of the name

props.name: suffix
props.description: the second word, after the icon

props.name: className
props.description: size it with a text size class (the icon follows the font size)
